selection: Highest six counts of original 2025/26 non-old-Top20 alt signals; alphabetical within ties. No outcome used. Retrospective pilot, not a historical investable universe.
clock: First observed hour hitting this side of the weekly extension after the NY civil Monday closes and through the original signal bar; freeze boxes completed on earlier 12H candles and still valid before the first touch. Earlier weekly touches may precede the original confirmed signal. No second-touch entry.
fvg: ChartPrime three UTC 12H bars, 200-bar population SD, threshold strictly >0.5, max 10 boxes combined, strict far-edge wick invalidation. Exclude insufficient indicator warmup and gaps opening through the line with no observed approach.
profile: Original Auto reconstructed from ten 72m candles over middle 12H, 15 bins. Use newest eligible zone if multiple. Compare level nearer the POC than the geometric midpoint vs midpoint as close or closer. Missing or alternate resolution excluded from primary POC contrast.
outcomes: Reuse original first-24h fixed stop and strict >10R chart and confirmation-close excursion labels, no trade/fill simulation. Count unknown outcomes separately. Matched expectation conditions on symbol, direction and signal year. No fitting or threshold scan.
